sources.reason: The city's own page for adult classes. Topics range from arts and music to health and wellness, parenting support, genealogy and new technology like AI. It is the main place for Westminster adult hobby and skills programs.

sources.name: Jefferson County Public Library (CO) – Events calendar
sources.reason: A calendar for the nearby Jeffco library system, which includes Arvada next to Westminster. You can filter it by type, such as DIY and Crafting. It lists recurring English as a Second Language classes, which are useful for adults new to the country.

events.title: English as a Second Language Class (Jefferson County Public Library)
events.why: A recurring free evening ESL class, listed Wednesdays 5:30–8:00pm. It could help Korean-speaking adults settling in. Check for current dates when you arrive in June 2027.
